question: Olympic medalist Vijender Singh belongs to which State of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vijender Singh** is an Indian professional boxer and former Olympic medalist.
 
• He won a bronze medal in the **2008 Beijing Olympics**, making him the first Indian boxer to win an Olympic medal.
 
• Vijender Singh hails from the state of **Haryana**.
 
• He has also won medals in various international competitions
